title: Classification du risque de D’Amico pour le cancer de la prostate
formula: Risque calculé par la combinaison des facteurs ci-dessus.

how_to_use.why: Fournit une stratification du risque pour étayer la planification pré-thérapeutique.
how_to_use.when: Use following a recent biopsy-confirmed diagnosis of localized prostate cancer to estimate post-treatment risk of biochemical (prostate-specific antigen [PSA]) recurrence.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Développé en 1998, cet outil estime le risque de récidive du cancer de la prostate (faible, moyen ou élevé) en fonction du taux de PSA, du [score de Gleason](nabda:calc.gleason-score-prostate-cancer) et du stade tumoral.
- Peut être moins précis chez les hommes présentant de multiples facteurs de risque.
- La distribution des groupes de risque observée dans la pratique actuelle a évolué vers une maladie davantage détectée par dépistage, ce qui peut limiter sa pertinence contemporaine.

next_steps.advice: Cet outil doit soutenir, et non remplacer, le jugement clinique et la décision partagée ; ne pas utiliser les résultats comme seul déterminant du traitement.
next_steps.management:
The following are based on guidelines from the American Urological Association (AUA), American Society for Radiation Oncology (ASTRO), and Society of Urologic Oncology (SUO) (also endorsed by the American Society of Clinical Oncology [ASCO]):

- **Very low-risk disease:** Active surveillance is the best available option.
- **Low-risk disease:**

 - Active surveillance is the preferred option for most patients.
 - Select low-risk patients at high probability of progressing on active surveillance may instead be offered definitive treatment (radical prostatectomy or radiotherapy).
- **Intermediate-risk disease:** Treatment options depend on shared decision-making between the patient and clinician and on whether the disease is determined to be favorable or unfavorable after further evaluation.

 - **For unfavorable disease:** Radical prostatectomy or radiotherapy combined with androgen-deprivation therapy are the standard treatment options.
 - **For favorable disease:**

 - Radiation alone is an option, although the supporting evidence is less robust than for radiation combined with androgen-deprivation therapy.
 - Active surveillance may be offered to select patients with counseling that this carries a higher risk of eventual metastasis than definitive treatment.
- **High-risk disease:** Radical prostatectomy or radiotherapy combined with androgen-deprivation therapy are the standard treatment options.

more_info:
**Low risk:**

- [Gleason Score](nabda:calc.gleason-score-prostate-cancer) <6 **and**
- PSA <10 ng/ml **and**
- Clinical stage T1c or T2a

**Intermediate risk:**

- [Gleason Score](nabda:calc.gleason-score-prostate-cancer) of 7 **or**
- PSA of 10-20 ng/ml **or**
- Clinical stage T2b

**High risk:**

- [Gleason Score](nabda:calc.gleason-score-prostate-cancer) >8 **or**
- PSA >20 ng/ml **or**
- Clinical stage T2c or T3
